entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Hi. I... I ordered this jersey, and I'm just so confused. I think I need to send it back, but the website was a lot to take in.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to be clear, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it more of a preference issue?

A preference, I guess? I got the ProFit jersey, but it's the wrong size. It's just... far too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping for an exchange, but I couldn't figure out the forms. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let's get this sorted out for you right away. No need to worry about the website. I can see your order here. You received it 19 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. Is that a problem?

Not at all. Let me just check the policy for that item... Okay, I see here that the ProFit jersey has a 90-day return window. You are well within that period, so we can absolutely process an exchange for a different size for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I thought I might have missed the deadline.

You're all set. And I see you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'm going to process the exchange with complimentary expedited shipping on the new size, so you'll have it in just a day or two. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack up the original jersey and drop it off with the carrier.
Wow, that is fantastic. You've made this so easy. Thank you, David!
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thanks again for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
